def _parts_v3(canonical, rows, replays):
    """Bind integrated Assembly display to complete source-bound replay-3 evidence."""
    from . import part_snapshot_bridge, result_v3
    from .geometry_evidence import validate_geometry_check

    sources = canonical["part_sources"]
    _require(
        list(replays) == [source["source_document_id"] for source in sources][: len(replays)],
        "source replay order differs from canonical source order",
    )
    outputs = {}
    for source in sources:
        # Preflight every source, even an unused one or one after a failed replay.
        document = part_snapshot_bridge._expected_document(source["document"])
        _require(
            fingerprint(document) == fingerprint(source["document"]),
            "source replay requires canonical Part source",
        )
        result_v3._graph(document, replay=True)
        identifier = source["source_document_id"]
        if identifier not in replays:
            continue
        replay = replays[identifier]
        body = replay["replay"]
        result_v3._validate_replay_body(document, body)
        projection = [
            {key: feature[key] for key in ("id", "status", "error", "stats", "output")}
            for feature in body["features"]
        ]
        _require(
            replay["status"] == body["status"]
            and fingerprint(replay["features"]) == fingerprint(projection),
            "source replay summary differs from complete replay evidence",
        )
        outputs[identifier] = {feature["id"]: feature for feature in body["features"]}
    failed = [identifier for identifier, replay in replays.items() if replay["status"] != "ok"]
    _require(
        not failed or failed == list(replays)[-1:] and not rows,
        "assembly continued or published parts after failed source replay",
    )
    if rows:
        _require(
            list(rows) == [part["id"] for part in canonical["parts"]]
            and len(replays) == len(sources),
            "part publication requires all canonical definitions and source replays",
        )
    for row in rows.values():
        source = outputs[row["source_document_id"]]
        output_id = row["output_feature_id"]
        _require(output_id in source, "selected assembly output is missing from source replay")
        feature = source[output_id]
        _require(
            feature["status"] == "ok" and feature["output"] == {"kind": "solid", "display": "mesh"},
            "selected assembly output is not an evaluated solid",
        )
        _require(
            fingerprint(row["mesh"]) == fingerprint(feature["mesh"])
            and fingerprint(row["topology"]) == fingerprint(feature["topology"]),
            "part display differs from selected source replay geometry",
        )
        checks = row["geometry_check"]
        validate_geometry_check(
            checks,
            linear_deflection=checks["linear_deflection_mm"],
            stats=feature["stats"],
            mesh=row["mesh"],
        )

def validate_snapshot_source(document: Document) -> None:
    """Admit legacy intent or the existing bounded sector-solid source shape.

    This remains serialization-only: formulas and unsolved point seeds are not
    evaluated or rewritten. Fresh replay owns resolved dimensions and geometry.
    Unsupported schema-3 shapes retain the original result-policy rejection.
    """
    profiles = [
        feature
        for feature in document.features
        if feature.sketch is not None and feature.sketch.schema_version == 3
    ]
    if len(profiles) == 1 and len(document.features) == 2:
        profile = profiles[0]
        extrusion = next(feature for feature in document.features if feature is not profile)
        sketch = profile.sketch
        if (
            profile.kind == "sketch_constrained"
            and extrusion.kind == "extrude"
            and dict(extrusion.inputs) == {"profile": profile.id}
            and document.active_feature == extrusion.id
            and len(sketch.arcs) == 1
            and len(sketch.lines) == 2
            and not sketch.circles
            and sketch.plane.origin == (0, 0, 0)
            and sketch.plane.quaternion == (1, 0, 0, 0)
        ):
            arc = sketch.arcs[0]
            radii = {frozenset((arc.center, arc.start)), frozenset((arc.center, arc.end))}
            height = extrusion.params["length"]
            if {frozenset((line.start, line.end)) for line in sketch.lines} == radii and (
                type(height) is str or 1 <= height <= 1000
            ):
                return
    validate_result_version(document, 2)
